q: What is CodeBite and what was the hardest part of building it?
answer: CodeBite is an algorithm practice platform built on deliberate practice, in Korean. It is inspired by Anders Ericsson's research: problems at the right level, immediate feedback, and spaced repetition. The hardest part of building it was submission-to-result latency was over 30 seconds.
